maya (docs): pasted compact examples below for review. keeping them short so CI run is cheap.

maya (docs): ```python
# python streaming + retry
from redwood import Client
import asyncio
client = Client()
async def one():
  async for c in client.stream_generate("TL;DR this doc", max_tokens=64, retry_policy={"backoff":"exp","max_retries":2}):
    print(c.text)
    break
asyncio.run(one())
```

maya (docs): ```ts
// ts streaming snippet
const s = client.streamGenerate({ prompt: 'TL;DR this doc', maxTokens: 64 });
for await (const c of s) { console.log(c.text); break }
```
